notes: Fixed: the in-app updater re-downloaded the same update APK from scratch every time you reopened the app without installing it, and left old, superseded update files behind in your Downloads folder - it now reuses an already-downloaded update and cleans up the old one once a newer version replaces it. The background station/TV refresh could redundantly re-fetch the station list over the network even when it was already fresh - it now skips the network call when nothing's actually stale.
